text: So you can now make walk style collage animations like this using claw without animating a single frame. The paper cutout style you see in explainer videos and documentaries and claw can now build it for you inside a real video editor. So here is how to do it. Head over to invidio's mcp page and select claw, hit connect then copy the prompt for your agent and paste it into claw and it will finish the setup by itself. Now you can drop new reference folders ask it to make it an explainer on any topic you want. Not only that it doesn't just give you a video file it builds a full video timeline inside invidio video timeline that you can edit. If you want the full setup guide drop here in the comments and I'll send them over.
